# meltcloud_nest_versions (Data Source)

The Nest versions a `meltcloud_nest` can run. Needs the API Key of the admin Organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meltcloud_nest_versions" "all" {}

# the newest nest version that is not revoked
locals {
  newest_nest = [
    for version in data.meltcloud_nest_versions.all.versions : version.name if !version.revoked
  ][0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `versions` (Attributes List) The Nest versions this installation knows, newest first (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `eol_date` (String) Date the version stops being supported
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version the Nest runs with it
- `name` (String) Name of the Nest version, as its `version` takes it
- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether the version was withdrawn. A revoked version cannot be updated to
